figures.caption: AS-hepc3(47-71) and AS-hepc3(48-56) kill P. aeruginosa PAO1 without inducing resistance selection after serial passaging treatment in the presence of sub-MIC. Antibiotics for comparisons, (A) Piperacillin; (B) Aztreonam; (C) Ceftazidime and Cefepime; (D) Imipenem and Meropenem; (E) Ciprofloxacin and Levofloxacin; (F) Gentamicin and Tobramycin; (G) Polymyxin B and Colistin.
